accounting.V1: app.broker.accounting: spread and slippage are inside the fill price, commission and FX are cash charges subtracted once; net_pnl = gross_pnl(fill prices) - cash charges; for a closed book, equity delta = sum(net_pnl)
accounting.V0: net_pnl = gross_pnl - total_cost (price-embedded spread and slippage charged a second time); rows written this way are LEGACY and never enter official metrics

STRATEGY_E_MAX_V1.application: raw-price fills; the round-trip total is charged once, on the entry fill, on entry notional

official_start.setting: AE_OFFICIAL_PAPER_START (ET session date, YYYY-MM-DD) in the usb-backend environment
official_start.rule: set to the first XNYS session that runs after ACCOUNTING_V1 and the E cost contract are deployed and verified; one date for A and E
official_start.unset_means: NOT_STARTED: official metrics are empty and no gate clock runs
official_start.before_start: LEGACY (V0) or PRE_OFFICIAL rows, shown for reference only

books.STRATEGY_A: paper DB account; official = trades entered and daily rows on or after the start; each must detect as V1
books.STRATEGY_E_MAX_V1: run/paper_state_v1/OFFICIAL_KIWOOM_PAPER (V1); run/paper_state is legacy V0, read-only
